_meta.description: Skill catalog used for CV parsing, matching and forecasting.

fields.task: Plain description of the work this skill involves, written in the style of O*NET task statements. Model 1 reads it to estimate how much of it AI can do.
fields.signal: id of the arXiv trend signal in signals.json that sets how fast AI tools arrive for this skill.

_meta.exposure_source: Model 1 (trained on 19,265 human-rated O*NET tasks, Eloundou et al. 2023) reading each skill's task description and your own CV sentence
